_comment: Zero-shot hazard detectors. Each one is just a label and a few descriptions - CLIP does the rest, with no training data. Edit freely, or add them live from the dashboard.

hazards.label: Black ice
prompts: a road covered in black ice
an icy road surface with a thin transparent glaze
a frozen road in freezing conditions

hazards.label: Snow
prompts: a road under a layer of fresh snow

hazards.label: Fog
prompts: a road in thick fog with very low visibility
a foggy road where the distance disappears into haze
